context: Tests whether /test-case-coverage audits the journey TC-001 read-only through the uc-coverage-layered agent (shipped in .claude/agents) in a Vaadin Flow + jOOQ project with a vaadin-e2e-test E2E layer. The input is deliberately partial: TC001FirstRegistrationIT covers Flow rows 1–4 and Validation 1, but Flow row 5 only checks that a grid is visible after a direct navigation, Flow row 6 (Ada Keller listed with the email) is never asserted, and Validation 2 (one registration in the participant list) is never asserted. The registration view and the test add a mandatory terms-and-conditions checkbox that neither TC-001 nor UC-002 describes.

checklist.name: Resolved arguments stated
checklist.description: Before the audit, the agent states the resolved arguments in one line, e.g. 'Auditing TC-001, mode both.'

checklist.name: Delegated to the auditor
checklist.description: The agent hands the audit to the uc-coverage-layered sub-agent with only the id and mode (e.g. 'TC-001 both'), without a list of files or expected findings — or, when it cannot run a sub-agent, reads agents/uc-coverage-layered.md and follows its checklist itself

checklist.name: No file changed
checklist.description: No file is created, modified, or deleted — not the journey test, not the views, not TC-001 and its **Status:** line. The missing assertions are not added

checklist.name: Journey units in the matrix
checklist.description: The matrix has one row per Flow row (Steps 1–6, verification rows included), per Validation item (1 and 2), and per Postcondition (2) of TC-001 — the units of a test case, not the main success scenario steps and business rules of the chained use cases

checklist.name: Step 6 gap
checklist.description: The report states that Flow row 6 (Verify participant: Ada Keller listed with the email) has no assertion — the test only checks that a grid is visible after step 5 — and does not mark it Covered

checklist.name: Validation 2 gap
checklist.description: The report states that Validation 2 (the participant list shows 1 registration) is not asserted anywhere in the journey test

checklist.name: Covered rows backed by evidence
checklist.description: Flow rows 1–4 and Validation 1 (1 free place) are reported as covered with a file and line in TC001FirstRegistrationIT.java, not as missing

checklist.name: Terms checkbox as drift
checklist.description: The report identifies the mandatory terms-and-conditions checkbox (RegisterForWorkshopView and the test step that checks it) as drift that neither TC-001 nor UC-002 describes, names both sides — update the test case and specification, or remove it from the application — and asks the user to decide instead of choosing

checklist.name: Commands and status
checklist.description: The agent offers /test-case-implement TC-001 for the missing test steps, runs no command itself, suggests the next **Status:** value only as a suggestion (Automated is not yet justified), and does not claim to have run the journey test
